text: 中金公司公告，经向上海证券交易所申请，公司A股股票于2026年9月15日开市起停牌实施A股异议股东收购请求权申报，申报期截至2026年9月17日结束。申报结果详见与本公告同日发布的《中国国际金融股份有限公司关于公司换股吸收合并东兴证券股份有限公司、信达证券股份有限公司之A股异议股东收购请求权申报结果的公告》。经向上海证券交易所申请，公司A股股票将于2026年9月23日开市起复牌，敬请广大投资者注意。
text_en: CICC announced that, upon application to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the company's A-shares were suspended from trading starting from the market open on September 15, 2026, to implement the declaration of the acquisition request right for A-share dissenting shareholders, with the declaration period ending on September 17, 2026. The declaration results are detailed in the "Announcement of China International Capital Corporation Limited on the Declaration Results of the Acquisition Request Right for A-Share Dissenting Shareholders Regarding the Company's Share Exchange Absorption Merger of Dongxing Securities Co., Ltd. and Xinda Securities Co., Ltd." published on the same day as this announcement. Upon application to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the company's A-shares will resume trading from the market open on September 23, 2026. Investors are kindly requested to pay attention.
